projects.name: MAG City - Phase 2 - MAG Eye
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of the Keturah Reserve in Mohammed Bin Rashid City, District 7 in Meydan. The project offers a variety of housing options to cater to different preferences and lifestyles. The project consists of 93 townhouses, 90 villas, 533 units spread across six apartment block buildings, and eight penthouse apartments.

The community at Keturah Reserve boasts several communal spaces for residents to enjoy. The Park provides an outdoor space where residents can relax, socialize, or engage in recreational activities. There is also an outdoor pool for residents to cool off and enjoy leisure time. The development includes separate women's and men's gyms, ensuring that residents have convenient access to fitness facilities. Additionally, there are spas where residents can unwind and rejuvenate.

The project is conceived to create a thriving and harmonious community with communal spaces like The Park, the outdoor pool, women’s and men’s gyms, and spas.

MAG City - Phase 2 - MAG Eye is a greenfield low rise (1 -3) project in Dubai, valued at USD 816.0 million, at design. Developed by Mag Property Development (Mag Group),Meydan Llc. projects.name: Abu Al Kizan Shoreline Village - Khorffakkan

The designs of the project’s buildings and amenities will be inspired by the Italian village of Riomaggiore. The village design takes a spiral shape to accommodate the mountain it is built upon, where the valley acts as a central road with buildings on both sides. The project consists of two parts: The first part is located on the shoreline and is about 60,000 sqm in area. projects.name: Development of Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary
projects.description:
The project involves the development of Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary, which seeks to enhance the sanctuary’s ecosystem and biodiversity. Aims to enhance biodiversity, preserve the sustainability of natural habitats, and reinforce the sanctuary’s position as a premier sustainable eco-tourism destination offering a unique and integrated experience that further enriches quality of life for residents and visitors alike.

The project is split into 2 phases. Phase one will cover approximately 6.4 square kilometres of the sanctuary.

New Features:

  • Creation of a new mangrove lake
  • Development of North Edge Lake
  • Addition of reed ponds

Green Spine Construction: A central ecological corridor will be developed.

Water Bodies Expansion:

  • 74 hectares of water bodies to be introduced
  • Represents a 144% increase in water coverage

Environmental Benefits:

  • 60% increase in carbon dioxide absorption
  • Supports climate change mitigation efforts
  • 10 hectares of new mudflats (salt flats) to promote local biodiversity and ecosystem support.

The second phase, to be implemented at a later stage.

  • Visitor centre showcasing flora, fauna, and educational exhibits
  • Birdwatching towers, restaurants, kiosks, and recreational zones
  • 5.6 km cycling tracks and 3 km walking trails through natural landscapes
  • 23 hectares of landscaping
  • Facilities to host events and activities
Development of Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary is a greenfield zoo and animal reserve project in Dubai, valued at USD 177.0 million, at under construction (2.0 percent complete). Developed by Dubai Municipality (Dm). Lead consultant Ae7 Consultant (Dubai); MEP consultant Ae7 Consultant (Dubai). Main contractor Waagner Biro Gulf Llc (Dubai); MEP contractor Waagner Biro Gulf Llc (Dubai). Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

projects.name: The Hamdan Bin Rashid Cancer Charity Hospital
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of The Hamdan Bin Rashid Cancer Charity Hospital. Spanning 56,000 square meters, the seven-storey hospital will be Dubai’s first fully modular-built hospital. The modular concept allows flexibility for future expansion and reduces design time by 50 percent, construction time by 30 percent, and cost by 20 percent.

Situated in the Al Jaddaf area, the hospital is designed to include 50 clinics, 30 clinical research areas, 60 infusion rooms, 10 urgent care rooms, 5 radiotherapy rooms, and 116 inpatient beds. Creating a healing atmosphere, the hospital campus will feature 19 gardens.

The comprehensive cancer hospital will benefit from a multidisciplinary team, including specialized nursing, offering patients a complete range of care services in one location, from early diagnosis to treatment and supportive care.

The Hamdan Bin Rashid Cancer Charity Hospital is a greenfield hospital project in Dubai, valued at USD 204.2 million, at under construction (100.0 percent complete). Developed by Dar Mix (Ajman) (Diyar Ajman General Contracting Llc),Dubai Development Authority (Dda),Al Jalila Foundation,Dubai Health Authority (Dha). projects.name: Dubai Mountain Summit Complex - Hatta Development Plan
projects.description: The project involves the development of a Dubai mountain Summit Complex at an altitude of 1,300 meters. It includes the construction of a 5.4-kilometer cable car and luxury hotels to transport tourists to the summit of Um Al Nesoor. The cable car route passes over the Hatta Dam lake and the upper dam lake, which are parts of the Hatta pumped-storage hydroelectricity plant currently under construction, as well as over the mountains. The route ends at the summit of the Um Al Nesoor mountain. The project features three main stops. The departure station will be built on an upper platform above the Hatta dam The intermediate stop will have a viewing platform and facilities to serve tourists The top station will include a panoramic viewing platform and facilities The project also includes hiking tracks and recreational facilities in addition to other world-class tourism services. The project aims to support development plans in Hatta and enhance its position as one of the most prominent tourist attractions in the emirate of Dubai and in the UAE. Dubai Mountain Summit Complex - Hatta Development Plan is a greenfield landmark, museum & galleries project in Dubai, valued at USD 300.0 million, at tender. projects.name: Ritz-Carlton Residences - Dubai Creek
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of The Ritz-Carlton Residences in Dubai Creekside, comprising 249 residences spread across seven buildings and 12 mansions. These 12 mansions consist of four levels with basement, a ground floor and 2 additional floors offering eight bedrooms, a majlis, a spa, a cinema room, and a premium gym equipped with modern facilities. Each mansion follows one of two architectural themes: earth (46,648.2 square feet) and water (45,927.24 square feet).

Part of the Keturah Resort, the project offers residents a host of world-class amenities, including a five-star wellness hotel, a private members-only club, a women's club, a kids club, a holistic wellness center, Michelin-star restaurants, a 550-meter promenade, sustainable retail spaces, round-the-clock private parking with valet service, and a gated community with wildlife sanctuary views.

The 12 mansions, themed Earth, Water, and Sky, are meticulously designed both externally and internally, drawing inspiration from natural elements to offer unique living experiences. They feature covered terraces for outdoor living, glass-framed courtyards, and adjustable architectural screens that blend interiors with gardens, ensuring seamless transitions and enhancing residents' interactions with their surroundings.

projects.name: Dubai Police Academy - Al Ruwayyah 1
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of the Dubai Police Academy in Al Ruwayyah 1, which spans 155 hectares (1.55 square kilometers) and is designed to serve as a comprehensive training and educational facility. The development is divided into four main areas:

  • Residential Area: This section accommodates 1,200 male and female cadets and newcomers, offering all essential service facilities. It includes dining facilities such as restaurants and social clubs with a capacity of 1,367 people, as well as libraries, prayer rooms, and a daily training field.
  • Academic Area: This area features college buildings, advanced educational and administrative facilities, offices for administrative and academic staff, the General Training Administration, a health center, and a 1,000-seat theatre.
  • Sports Area: Equipped with 17 sports facilities, this section includes an indoor gym, indoor and outdoor swimming pools, a football field, outdoor courts for tennis and volleyball, and a residential hotel with 26 rooms for sports teams.
  • Main Academy Field: Designed to accommodate 2,500 attendees and spectators, this area includes a 'training city' for police operations.


Additional features of the academy include a 1,444-vehicle parking area, 3.3 km running and cycling tracks, and future plans to add officer accommodations with a capacity for 108 people.

Dubai Police Academy - Al Ruwayyah 1 is a greenfield mid rise (4 - 14) project in Dubai, valued at USD 528.1 million, at under construction. Developed by Dubai Holding,Dubai Police (General Headquarters). Lead consultant Ae7 Consultant (Dubai). No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

projects.name: Alaya Gardens (Phase B) - Tilal Al Ghaf
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of 235 villas, located at Tilal Al Ghaf. All of the villas sit on sizable plots to promote a desirable air of seclusion. The plot widths extend from 16 metres to 23 metres, with the built-up area (BUA) ranging from 557 square metres for the four-bedroom Haven, to nearly 929 square metres for the six-bedroom Reserve grand villa.

With an architectural design approach inspired by the biophilic aesthetic, grand villas at Alaya Gardens feature an abundance of natural materials juxtaposed with striking geometric detailing that works as a harmonious whole while promoting an effortless flow between interior and exterior spaces; metal louvre detailing, natural stone and porcelain tiles in a choice of understated shades add an organic elegance both indoors and out. The boundaries are further blurred by judicious use of open layouts and double-height spaces, with expansive floor-to-ceiling windows to let in ample natural light and allow unparalleled vistas of the lush green surroundings that set this exceptional neighbourhood apart. Alaya Gardens (Phase B) - Tilal Al Ghaf is a greenfield low rise (1 -3) project in Dubai, valued at USD 315.1 million, at under construction (8.0 percent complete). projects.name: The Luxury Collection Resort & Residences - Al Marjan Island

The resort will feature 466 rooms and suites, along with 29 expansive villas, designed to offer a unique and elevated luxury experience. The resort will include several high-end amenities, such as multiple dining venues, a spa, fitness center, kids club, swimming pool, and a padel court. Additionally, the property will offer more than 3,500 square meters of meeting and event space, including a 1,300-square-meter ballroom.

In addition to the resort, the project will include 392 branded residences, which will offer one to five-bedroom apartments, and 55 luxury villas. The residential development will provide an exceptional living experience, with access to resort-style amenities and services on demand. This development is poised to enhance Ras Al Khaimah’s position as a premier destination for both luxury living and tourism.

The development includes various luxurious elements, such as 'The Private Residence at MOON Dubai' consisting of 500 upscale residential units, an exclusive Private Members Club, a boutique Six Star hotel with 100 suites, and a Five Star hotel with 4000 suites. Guests can look forward to over 50 integrated components, including an exceptional attraction that allows them to walk on the Lunar Surface and explore an authentic Lunar Colony, which is a signature experience offered by MOON. Complete with fully equipped Fendi Kitchens, al fresco dining spaces, and personal outdoor terraces boasting Sky Pools, residents have plenty of room to host gatherings and unwind in elegance. The Sky Gardens afford stunning vistas of the water canal and verdant Safa Park, enhancing the overall living experience.

projects.name: Agri Hub - Dubai
projects.description: The project involves the construction of an Agri Hub located in Dubai which aims to become the world's largest eco-agritourism destination. Agri Hub is a highly attractive and activity-rich environment, which will transform Dubai into the world’s best rural visitor attraction in the world. It will provide spaces for local farmers to sell their products directly from their farms, whilst offering a new eco-friendly shopping, dining & edutainment experience for visitors. Beyond becoming a new tourism experience in the countryside and wilderness of Dubai, the project will also promote greater health, well-being, and prosperity for rural local inhabitants. The new hub will also feature a nature & heritage conservation center, an ecotourism center, an Agri-tech institute & a restorative wellness center. The conservation center will protect natural reserves & archaeological sites. The ecotourism center will offer heritage trips to ancient sites in the region, whilst also offering eco-friendly adventures such as camel riding, horse riding and desert walks. The Agri-tech institute will support farmers and provide investment opportunities for local inhabitants. The new destination will also provide health and well-being facilities with sports-focused activities. Medical facilities as well as a restorative wellness center will also promote medical tourism. Agri Hub is intertwined with a unique landscape which will be publicly accessible and offers outdoor leisure facilities, camps & lodges. The landscape is also integrated with biosaline agriculture, renewable energy production & outdoor facilities for visitors and local residents. Some of the project’s environmental features include 100% renewable energy, 100% water recycling and onsite zero waste management. The project will include 20 kilometers of dedicated cycling tracks. Agri Hub - Dubai is a greenfield mega urban development project in Dubai, valued at USD 100.0 million, at concept. Developed by Urb Planning. No consultant recorded. No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

projects.name: Louvre Residences - Saadiyat Grove - Saadiyat Island

The project involves the construction of a residential complex comprising 421 units, retail spaces, and community facilities situated in Saadiyat Grove. The project includes studios, and 1, 2, 3, and 5-bedroom apartments. The project will offer unrivaled views, sophisticated designs, spacious layouts, and exceptional amenities for residents.

The project will have a 360-degree view of three museums on the island. projects.name: Vertical City
projects.description:
The project involves the development of a sustainable Vertical City-building with 100,000 people settled in the water. The building incorporates renewable energy resources and energy storage solutions, water desalination, and food production/farming with a zero-waste policy. The building has green areas, natural light and ventilation, 100% green transport systems, and is based on a modular, prefabricated structure with photovoltaic glass for energy independence. The design aims to promote a healthier lifestyle and rethink the traditional concept of community and society.

The city building is a vertical structure with 180 floors, 750 meters in height. It has a green area of 200,000 square meters, including a public garden at the top, and incorporates farming, social space, and self-sufficiency. The structure consists of 10 modular layers, each with 18 floors, housing apartments, duplexes, and villas, as well as offices, stores, and other facilities. The building is energy-independent and has a green transport system. The structure is designed for natural light and air circulation and includes community spaces for water baths, markets, spiritual, and cultural hubs.

The Vertical City can be reached by water, land, or air. It has an equipped circular basement with external and internal docks and three naval entries, including external berths for large boats and internal navigation for smaller boats. The mainland is connected via a semi-submersed bridge for pedestrians and electric transport, and the tower has heliports connected to the upper garden square and vertical linking installations. Vertical City is a greenfield mega urban development project in Dubai, valued at USD 200.0 million, at concept. The developer is not yet recorded. No consultant recorded. No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

projects.name: Design Quarter - Dubai Design District
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of a premium residential development within Dubai Design District (d3), marking the first residential community in this globally recognized creative hub. The development comprises 558 residential units, including one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, duplexes, and penthouses, across three architecturally distinct towers—one low-rise and two high-rise structures.

Designed to foster a seamless balance between work and lifestyle, the project features high-quality materials and superior finishes throughout. Residents will have access to a range of amenities, including a landscaped podium with co-working spaces, an indoor-outdoor gym, swimming pools, barbecue areas, and children's play zones. Additional facilities include gardens, jogging paths, sports fields, tennis courts, and a double-level infinity pool, ensuring a vibrant and active community.

Strategically located, the development offers direct access to Dubai’s creative, fashion, and design scene, while providing breathtaking views of the Burj Khalifa and the Dubai Water Canal. With its proximity to Downtown Dubai and Business Bay, the project creates an ideal urban sanctuary for residents seeking a dynamic and inspiring living environment.

projects.name: Mar Casa - Dubai Maritime City
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of the Mar Casa luxury residential tower located in Dubai Maritime City. The 52-floor tower seamlessly blends the beauty of the sea with modern metropolis design. The project comprises 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, and luxury penthouses with floor-to-ceiling windows and balconies, offering panoramic views of the ocean and Dubai's skyline. The unique sea wave-inspired façade creates a harmonious connection between land and sea, positioning Mar Casa as a pioneer in emotional luxury development.

Mar Casa offers a smart and sustainable lifestyle, featuring living spaces with daylight integration, energy-efficient light fixtures, superior indoor air quality, and energy-efficient MEP systems. A full floor of world-class recreational amenities includes an indoor and outdoor resident's lounge, padel court, yoga and breakout spaces, kids play area, and kids club. A roof-top infinity pool with breathtaking views offers the ideal space for relaxation, while a separate children's pool and beach-inspired pool with splash areas are also available on the main recreational floor.

Every apartment and penthouse at Mar Casa is a smart home equipped with advanced IP intercoms, smart access and lighting control systems, and premium-brand appliances. The luxurious units offer a wide range of options, with one-bedroom units ranging from 740-1265 sq. ft. Two-bedroom apartments and duplexes range between 1100-3285 sq. ft., while three-bedroom apartments and duplexes are available from 1850-4170 sq. ft. The ultra-luxury Executive and Royal duplex penthouses offer between 2780-5830 sq. ft. of built-up area.

Mar Casa is perfectly connected to Dubai's old city, financial center, and Jumeirah area, with Dubai Downtown landmarks like the Dubai Mall and Burj Khalifa only a ten-minute drive away. A sustainable development in line with the UAE's vision for a healthy environment, Mar Casa presents exceptional amenities, smart and sustainable infrastructure, and world-class construction quality.

Mar Casa - Dubai Maritime City is a greenfield high rise (15+) project in Dubai, valued at USD 300.0 million, at under construction. Developed by Deyaar Property Management Llc. projects.name: Jawaher Boston Medical District - Emirates Bypass Road
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of Jawaher Boston Medical District on Emirates Bypass Road, Sharjah. The project will include hospitals, centers, institutes, and laboratories that will provide health care with the best methods and standards. The project will house a cutting-edge 266-bed hospital, providing advanced medical care, including specialized services in women’s health, oncology, and pediatrics.

The project will also contribute significantly to the field of medical studies and research in general, and to cancer diseases in particular, by benefiting from the expertise of the Mass General Brigham Hospitals Network, the Dana-Farber Cancer Institute, and other scientific and research institutes in the Emirate of Sharjah, among others.

The project envisions vibrant, sustainable communities, centered around an iconic solar-panel canopy that offers shade and generates clean energy. This innovative design creates a lush microclimate, reducing temperatures by up to 4°C compared to its surroundings and enabling the hospital to achieve net-zero energy. The hospital is surrounded by thousands of native trees and orchards, promoting healing and well-being in harmony with nature.

projects.name: Bugatti Residences by Binghatti - Business Bay
projects.description:
The project will involve the construction of the world's first Bugatti Residences in Business Bay. The 46-floor tower will include 171 Riviera Mansions, and 11 Sky Mansion penthouses aiming to bring the exclusive Bugatti lifestyle to life.  Each unit in the Bugatti Residences by Binghatti offers stunning views of the Dubai Water Canal and the Burj Khalifa Downtown. The project features two-, three-, and four-bedroom penthouses, each named after iconic destinations like Cannes, St Tropez, and Monaco. Inspired by the French Riviera and Dubai's dunes, the residences boast exterior contours resembling ripples. the units will range from 185 sqm to 4,087 sqm.

The first Bugatti residence will include a beach inspired by the Riviera, a private pool, a jacuzzi spa, a fitness club, a chef's table, private valet service, a members club, and two car lifts from the garage to the penthouse. Each unit will have its dedicated parking space, and the highest penthouse will accommodate up to 20 parking slots. Additionally, one floor will serve as an exhibition space for special cars owned by residents.

Inspired by Bugatti's French heritage and expert craftsmanship, the residences will embody the tranquil ambience of the French Riviera. Designed to evoke the same emotions as Bugatti's hyper sports cars, the Bugatti Residences will be an architectural masterpiece, blending elegance and sophistication in the heart of Dubai. Bugatti Residences by Binghatti - Business Bay is a greenfield high rise (15+) project in Dubai, valued at USD 1000.0 million, at under construction (12.0 percent complete). Developed by Binghatti Holding (Binghatti Developers),Bugatti Dubai,Kubr Properties. Lead consultant Silver Stone Engineering Consultants; MEP consultant Silver Stone Engineering Consultants. Main contractor Granada Europe Engineering Construction Llc; MEP contractor Granada Europe Engineering Construction Llc. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

The project involves the construction of a Floating Healthcare Island in Dubai. The core skyscraper is divided into two parts: the base, spanning 670,000 square meters, which accommodates educational activities, and the crescent, covering 330,000 square meters, dedicated to functions such as the exhibition hall, research and development department, science and technology park, library, and exhibition of digital achievements.

Following the core skyscraper, there will be 14 towers with medical functions, likely serving as medical facilities or hospitals. These towers will contribute to the island's infrastructure and provide healthcare services.

Furthermore, 24 hotels will be located on the two ends of the island, symmetrically framing the core skyscraper. These hotels will likely cater to visitors and tourists, offering accommodation and hospitality services.

To enhance the island's aesthetics and environmental sustainability, Kalbod Studio plans to line all the structures with terraces and rooftops featuring a variety of vegetation. This greenery will not only provide shade but also help with natural ventilation and contribute to improving Dubai's air quality. The integration of vegetation in the design is a sustainable approach that aligns with the growing trend of incorporating green spaces into urban environments.

Floating Healthcare Island is a greenfield mega urban development project in Dubai, valued at USD 700.0 million, at design. The developer is not yet recorded. Lead consultant Kalbod Design Studio. No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

The project offers high-end living inspired by nature, located on the water's edge and featuring the first-of-its-kind waterpark in the eastern region. It aims to create a thriving environment for families, communities, commerce, and tourism in a charming coastal town.

Spread across a reclaimed plot of 65,269 sqm, the project integrates luxurious housing and impressive facilities, including a Waterpark with thrilling slides and water sports, swimming pools, access to the beach, and public amenities. The development consists of 6 residential buildings, comprising 184 residences ranging from 2 to 4 bedrooms, including duplex options. The units have a saleable area ranging from 124 sqm to 417 sqm.

The unique landscape-style architecture features terraces on each level, offering panoramic views to residents above a state-of-the-art podium and retail space. The design takes inspiration from the coastal conditions, incorporating the fluidity and forms of the landform and sea.

The podium level provides various amenities and activities suitable for all ages, including lap and kids pools, creating an appealing living space with captivating water views.  The ground floors of the complex are dedicated to commercial spaces, offering necessary amenities for project owners while remaining easily accessible to residents. The gated community is conveniently located near Khorfakkan beach, just a 5-minute drive from the iconic amphitheater and waterfalls of the town.
